# okstatus_status_page (Resource)

A public OKStatus status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "okstatus_status_page" "public" {
  slug         = "example"
  title        = "Example Inc. Status"
  description  = "Live status of Example Inc.'s services."
  theme        = "auto"
  accent_color = "#00e599"
  published    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) URL slug (`status.okstatus.eu/<slug>`), lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Hex color, e.g. `#00e599`. Defaults to OKStatus's own default.
- `auto_refresh_interval` (Number) Seconds between automatic page refreshes (30-3600).
- `custom_css` (String)
- `custom_domain` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `favicon_url` (String)
- `footer_text` (String)
- `logo_url` (String)
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the page is publicly visible. Defaults to `true`.
- `theme` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
